title: FIFA World Cup 2026 — All 48 Qualified Teams with Monte Carlo Win Probability
subtitle: Real FIFA Rankings (Jan 2026) + 50,000 Monte Carlo Tournament Simulations
description:
Complete dataset of all 48 teams qualified for the 2026 FIFA World Cup (USA, Canada, Mexico). Includes official FIFA rankings and points as of January 19, 2026, squad quality metrics, historical WC performance, and Monte Carlo simulation probabilities for each tournament stage.

Monte Carlo methodology: 50,000 full tournament simulations. Each match outcome determined by Elo-style logistic probability based on composite team strength. Group stage: round-robin with 32 teams advancing (top 2 per group + best 8 third-place). Knockout: single elimination R32 → R16 → QF → SF → Final → Champion.

All win probabilities sum to 100%.

simulation_details.match_model: Logistic probability: P(A beats B) = 1 / (1 + exp(-(sA - sB) / 6.0))
simulation_details.group_format: 12 groups of 4. Top 2 + best 8 third-place = 32 advance
simulation_details.knockout_format: Single elimination: R32 → R16 → QF → SF → Final
simulation_details.draw_rate: 30% matches end in draw during group stage
